name: Missive
description: Missive is the email client teams run their business from: one shared inbox for email, WhatsApp, SMS, and the internal chat around them. Connecting Missive lets Claude search conversations across every channel in one pass, summarize threads and labels, look up contacts, calendars, and canned responses, and stage drafts with your team's signature applied. Ask who's still waiting on a reply, which customer emails are urgent this week, or what topics keep coming up in support. Claude drafts; your team reviews. Composing and delivering are separate steps, so nothing reaches a customer until someone approves it, and you can disable sending entirely for a draft-only setup.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Missive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Missive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.missiveapp.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Missive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Missive lists 14 MCP tools, including change_labels, compose_draft, get_calendar_events, get_contact_details, get_conversation_entries, get_conversations, get_search_results, list_calendars, manage_calendar_events, search_conversations, search_mailboxes, and search_responses.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Missive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Missive in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Missive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Missive is developed by Missive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
